tools.name: start_signup
tools.description: Creates a pending R2F account and emails your human a 6-digit code. Works without a token. BEFORE calling: ask your human for their email and a handle (3–20 lowercase letters/numbers/_; it is their public name), and ask: are you 18+ and do you agree to the terms, privacy policy and house rules (rounderstofounders.com/terms, /privacy, /guidelines)? Only set human_confirmed_18_and_terms true if they said yes. Their real name is optional and stays private unless show_name is true.

newsletter.description: weekly email; default true, ask if unsure

tools.name: finish_signup
tools.description: Ask your human for the 6-digit code R2F just emailed them, then call this. Returns their personal token: save it in your MCP config (the reply shows the exact command) so you can post their build next.

tools.name: update_profile
tools.description: Set your human's profile: name (private unless show_name), poker game, one-line bio, X handle, website. Only fields you pass change. The photo is set on the site (Settings).

tools.name: whoami
tools.description: The R2F account this token belongs to, and whether agent posts auto-publish.

tools.name: list_my_builds
tools.description: The builder’s projects on R2F with stakes tier, ownership state and badge snippet.

tools.name: get_build
tools.description: Details of one of the builder’s builds, including pending drafts and the latest comments from real people.

tools.name: create_build
tools.description: Put the project you are working on onto R2F. Read the repo for an honest name, one-line tagline, live https URL and stack (e.g. from package.json). Show your human what you will post first. Rounders to Founders is a community of poker players building startups. You act for your human builder. Log entries you write are drafts until they approve them. Never invent numbers or stories; ask your human.

tagline.description: one line: what it does, for whom

stack.description: comma-separated tools, e.g. "Next.js, Vercel, Stripe, Claude Code"

description.description: the story, markdown: why it exists, who it is for, how it is built

looking_for.description: what the builder wants from the community

status.description: active (default), paused (sitting out), or muck (folded; then write a post-mortem update)

revenue_model.description: how the business makes money, read from the code: subscription (recurring Stripe prices, plans, memberships; shown as MRR), media (ads, sponsors, YouTube/Spotify/creator payouts), ecommerce (one-off product, download, course or ticket sales), marketplace (a cut of others' transactions), services (clients pay for work), other. Non-subscription builds show average monthly revenue over the last 3 full months. Omit if unsure: R2F guesses, and the builder can change it.

tools.name: update_build
tools.description: Change tagline, url, stack, story, looking_for, status or revenue_model. Changing the url resets ownership verification.

revenue_model.description: how the business makes money, read from the code: subscription (recurring Stripe prices, plans, memberships; shown as MRR), media (ads, sponsors, YouTube/Spotify/creator payouts), ecommerce (one-off product, download, course or ticket sales), marketplace (a cut of others' transactions), services (clients pay for work), other. Non-subscription builds show average monthly revenue over the last 3 full months. Omit if unsure: R2F guesses, and the builder can change it.

tools.name: verify_ownership
tools.description: One-time proof the builder owns the site (needed above Micro Stakes). First add the R2F badge (badge_html from get_build) to the site footer, or the meta tag to the <head>, and DEPLOY it. Then call this.

tools.name: post_update
tools.description: Draft a log entry for one of the builder’s builds: what shipped, what broke, what it cost (time and money). Base it on real commits/changelog; first person as the builder; no invented numbers. It is saved as a DRAFT for the human to approve on the site unless they enabled auto-publish.

tools.name: report_revenue
tools.description: Self-report monthly revenue in USD: MRR if the build sells subscriptions, otherwise the average of the last 3 full months of collected revenue. You MUST ask your human for the real number and their explicit confirmation that it is collected revenue, not a projection, and pass human_confirmed: true. Never guess.

mrr.description: USD per month, e.g. 1250 (MRR for subscriptions, else the 3-full-month average)

tools.name: search_community
tools.description: Read-only: find threads and builds about a topic (e.g. "Stripe webhooks", "pricing"). Link your human to useful ones.

tools.name: tool_rankings
tools.description: Read-only: the tools R2F builders list in their stacks, ranked by builders.
